prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium Korean fantasy game achievement trophy, standalone transparent PNG. Create ONE exquisitely crafted elaborate trophy only, full silhouette centered on a square canvas, viewed nearly front-on with a little visible depth, an elegant sculptural collectible. Luxurious high-end 3D prerender / hand-painted fantasy game item finish, beautifully resolved metals and gemstones, dramatic controlled highlights, convincing weight. Strong readable silhouette at 160px. Entire trophy including base visible, 8% clean transparent margin all around, no clipping. True alpha transparent background, no backdrop, floor, cast ground shadow, rectangle, frame, poster, caption, typography, letters, numbers, watermark, or additional objects. Restrained tiny integrated glints are welcome, no large outer fog or opaque glow. Design as a polished final game asset. Primary request: a majestic dark trophy earned by defeating the Blackwing Oath raid fifteen times. A dark crowned greatsword planted vertically in an ornate black obsidian pedestal, with a brilliant deep crimson heart-shaped faceted core embedded in the blade's crossguard. Large symmetrical angular black dragon/bat wings curve up behind it, richly detailed charred metal wing ribs and wine-red membrane inlays. The sword is straight, strong and perfectly coherent. Blackened steel, antique pale gold sharp armor filigree, blood-red crystals, red internal ember light. A gothic winged covenant reliquary, beautiful, threatening and heroic; trophy rather than a full character. Elegant compact base with carved gilded trims. No text or numbers.
